# sherpa-notifications

The bell's list.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Wraps | [sherpa-menu](sherpa-menu.md) |
| Figma | Notifications |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-notifications/sherpa-notifications.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-notifications/sherpa-notifications.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-notifications/sherpa-notifications.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-notifications/sherpa-notifications.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-notifications/sherpa-notifications.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-button class="opener" data-type="icon" data-icon-start="notifications" aria-label="Notifications"></sherpa-button><sherpa-notifications></sherpa-notifications>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-notifications`:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "a",
    "label": "Renewed",
    "description": "Enterprise",
    "time": "2m ago",
    "unread": true
  },
  {
    "id": "b",
    "label": "Report ready",
    "time": "2d ago"
  }
]
```

`sherpa-notifications` is opened with `show()`, against `.opener`.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-empty` | text | `No notifications` | what to say when there is nothing |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unreadCount` | `number` | read only |  |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `show(trigger?: HTMLElement)` | Open the list, anchored to whatever opened it (the bell). |
| `hide()` |  |
| `close()` |  |
| `toggle(trigger?: HTMLElement)` | Open if shut, shut if open — what a bell click does. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `notification-select` | `{ id: string \| undefined; notification: Notification }` | A row was picked. |
| `notification-read` | `{ ids: string[] }` | "Mark all read" was pressed. |
| `notifications-open` |  | The list opened. |
| `notifications-close` |  | The list closed. |
